# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR CLEANLINESS TREATY TRIGGERS
# ============================================================================
# Scope contracts are stated above each trigger. Targeted treaty decisions use
# the documented decision scopes ROOT = acting country and FROM = target country.

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = {
	exists = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	has_capitulated = no
	num_of_controlled_states > constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero
	NOT = { is_actual_nonhuman_country = yes }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned }
	NOT = { has_used_unconventional_weapons = yes }
	is_within_air_cleanliness_treaty_condemnation_limit = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
is_air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
	is_major = yes
	has_government = democratic
	is_subject = no
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = {
	has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
	has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
	is_in_array = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		value = THIS
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_country_can_be_invited = {
	has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
	NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member }
	NOT = {
		is_in_array = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			value = THIS
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any
air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_is_valid = {
	has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
	has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
	event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder = {
		air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the delayed invitation recipient
air_cleanliness_treaty_pending_invitation_is_valid = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_can_be_invited = yes
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_is_valid = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the country viewing invitation options
air_cleanliness_treaty_can_accept_invitation = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_can_be_invited = yes
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_is_valid = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_current_founder = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
	has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
	event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder = { tag = PREV }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the secretariat country and FROM is the
# prospective inspection subject.
air_cleanliness_treaty_can_start_verification_mission = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_current_founder = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cooldown }
	NOT = {
		is_in_array = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
			value = THIS
		}
	}
	FROM = {
		exists = yes
		NOT = { tag = ROOT }
		air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
		NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active }
		NOT = {
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reserved }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_recent }
	}
	NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
	NOT = { has_equipment = { support_equipment < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_support_cost } }
	NOT = { has_equipment = { convoy_1 < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_convoy_cost } }
	NOT = { num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_civilian_factories }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the exact secretariat that owns the transaction.
air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction_is_valid = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_current_founder = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject
	is_in_array = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
		value = THIS
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
		exists = yes
		NOT = { tag = PREV }
		air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
		has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reserved
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation
		check_variable = {
			var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
			value = PREV
			compare = equals
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction
			value = PREV.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
			compare = equals
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation
			value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
			compare = equals
		}
	}
	NOT = { has_war_with = var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome }
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active }
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome }
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response }
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending
			has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.full_access compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.records_only compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.refused compare = equals }
			}
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending }
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending
				has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome
					value = PREV.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the Cleaning Day sponsor. The current sponsor and
# at least one other live signatory must remain in the bounded member array.
air_cleanliness_treaty_has_cleaning_day_quorum = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
	any_of_scopes = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
		NOT = { tag = ROOT }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_can_start_cleaning_day = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_has_cleaning_day_quorum = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = air_contamination_irreversible }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_in_progress }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_cooldown }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_bp
		value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_minimum_contamination_bp
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_bp
		value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.irreversible_100
		compare = less_than
	}
	NOT = { has_equipment = { support_equipment < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_support_cost } }
	NOT = { has_equipment = { convoy_1 < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_convoy_cost } }
	NOT = { num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects < constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_civilian_factories }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the project sponsor

		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction

		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_bp

		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_bp
		value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.irreversible_100
		compare = less_than
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the prospective convoy recipient
air_cleanliness_treaty_recipient_has_filter_convoy_state = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes

	var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		air_winter_is_active = yes
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_phase
			value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
		is_owned_by = PREV
		is_controlled_by = PREV
		has_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
		has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_response_priority_owner
			value = PREV
			compare = equals
		}
		NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route }
		NOT = { has_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the donor and FROM is the decision target.
air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_is_valid = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
	is_in_array = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
		value = THIS
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
		value = FROM
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	FROM = { air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes }
	NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
	var:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		air_winter_is_active = yes
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_phase
			value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
		is_owned_by = FROM
		is_controlled_by = FROM
		has_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
		has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
		check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor value = ROOT compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient value = FROM compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation compare = equals }
		NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. War alignment is checked after the two stored country
# scopes are recovered by the reconciliation effect.

	has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	has_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
	has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_generation
		value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	is_owned_by = var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
	is_controlled_by = var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
	var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor = { air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes }
	var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient = { air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes }
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_triggers/air_cleanliness_winter_triggers.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR CLEANLINESS WINTER SCRIPTED TRIGGERS
# ============================================================================
# Query contract for the deterministic Air Winter lifecycle.
# Unless noted otherwise, triggers in this file expect STATE scope. Presentation
# classes are supplied by a reviewed typed state-ID ledger. No climate or
# geography is inferred at runtime.
# ============================================================================

# Structural parser values for Phase 1 branch cardinality and the documented
# railway-presence trigger. These are invariants rather than tuning values.
@AIR_WINTER_PHASE_1_BRANCH_MINIMUM = 1
@AIR_WINTER_PHASE_1_BRANCH_MALFORMED = 2
@AIR_WINTER_PHASE_1_RAILWAY_LEVEL = 1

# Supported scope: any
air_winter_system_enabled = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = settings_air_cleanliness_disabled }
		has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_state_is_valid = {
	impassable = no
	owner = { exists = yes }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_excluded }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. In scripted mapmode localisation ROOT is the viewing
# player country and the checked scope is the hovered state, matching the
# official scripted-mapmode scope contract and the existing plague precedent.
air_winter_mapmode_player_has_basic_sampling = {
	ROOT = { exists = yes }
	OR = {
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		is_controlled_by = ROOT
		ROOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Completing one reviewed roof-sampler project creates
# a national atmospheric office. The capability is country-wide and persists
# across later state ownership changes until Air Winter is reset.
air_winter_mapmode_player_has_atmospheric_office = {
	ROOT = {
		exists = yes
		has_country_flag = air_winter_atmospheric_office
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Terminal modelling becomes public after ninety
# percent global contamination. Before then, a major power must have invested
# in an atmospheric office.
air_winter_mapmode_player_has_terminal_modelling = {
	ROOT = { exists = yes }
	OR = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.air_contamination_bp
			value = constant:air_winter_monitoring.terminal_contamination_bp
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
		ROOT = {
			is_major = yes
			has_country_flag = air_winter_atmospheric_office
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. One global generation is opened for each complete
# Fallout snapshot attempt, including retries on the same date.
air_winter_fallout_snapshot_generation_is_open = {
	has_variable = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
	has_variable = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
		value = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This is the Air Winter-owned canonical payload
# contract. A state receives a producer receipt only after every field passes.
air_winter_fallout_snapshot_payload_is_canonical = {
	air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
	has_state_flag = air_winter_initialized
	has_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded
	has_variable = air_winter_original_category
	has_variable = air_winter_phase
	has_variable = air_winter_exposure
	has_variable = air_winter_recovery
	has_variable = air_winter_adaptation
	has_variable = air_winter_food_reserve
	has_variable = air_winter_shelter_capacity
	has_variable = air_winter_reclamation
	has_variable = air_winter_water_security
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_original_category
		value = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_original_category
		value = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_phase
		value = constant:air_winter_phase.clear
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_phase
		value = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_exposure
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_exposure
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_recovery
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_recovery
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_adaptation
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_adaptation
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_food_reserve
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_food_reserve
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_shelter_capacity
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_shelter_capacity
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_reclamation
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_reclamation
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_water_security
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_water_security
		value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This receipt proves that Air Winter produced the
# canonical row during the currently open Fallout snapshot generation.
air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_receipt_is_current = {
	air_winter_fallout_snapshot_generation_is_open = yes
	air_winter_fallout_snapshot_payload_is_canonical = yes
	has_state_flag = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_produced
	has_variable = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
	has_variable = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
		value = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
		value = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation
		value = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation
		compare = equals
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. During the single monthly state pass, states already
# updated in the open cycle expose their previous phase. States not yet updated
# expose their current phase. Every neighbor therefore reads the same opening
# snapshot regardless of iterator order.
air_winter_was_severe_at_cycle_start = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
			has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			has_variable = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id
				value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_previous_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open }
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id
						value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Ordinary-map ground and prop assets exist only for

	check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_presentation_class
		value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = { air_winter_phase > constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_phase
		value = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Peak-phase memory makes thaw eligibility persist
# through a multi-month recovery instead of depending on iterator timing.
air_winter_visual_thaw_is_eligible = {
	air_winter_visual_has_active_class_phase = yes
	air_winter_trend_is_recovering = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_peak_phase_memory
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_peak_phase_memory
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. A downward phase step receives the stronger authored
# runoff frame for one monthly pulse. Continuing recovery uses the mild frame.
air_winter_visual_thaw_is_severe = {
	air_winter_visual_thaw_is_eligible = yes
	has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_previous_phase
		value = air_winter_phase
		compare = greater_than
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The phase threshold follows the regional handoff.
# low food allows the ecology marker to persist during active recovery.
air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_is_eligible = {
	air_winter_visual_has_active_class_phase = yes
	OR = {
		air_winter_has_low_food = yes
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.ash_winter compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Tropical, equatorial, and oceanic states receive no
# default frozen-water prop. Their recovery can still display runoff and flood.
air_winter_visual_frozen_water_is_eligible = {
	air_winter_visual_has_active_class_phase = yes
	NOT = { air_winter_visual_thaw_is_eligible = yes }
	OR = {
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		AND = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_response_category_is_visible = {
	air_winter_system_enabled = yes
	has_global_flag = air_winter_active
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	any_controlled_state = {
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		air_winter_is_active = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. Timed decision removal is a separate engine callback
# from the category and cancel triggers. This gate is checked immediately
# before a result effect is called so Fallout ownership wins same-day races.
air_winter_response_mutation_is_allowed = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Ownership remains in the calling decision so this
# query can also be reused by event and AI selection code.
air_winter_response_state_is_available = {
	air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
	air_winter_is_active = yes
	air_winter_response_is_priority_target = yes
	NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active }
	OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active } }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_cooldown }
		NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
	}
}

		value = ROOT
		compare = equals
	}
}

	is_owned_by = ROOT
	is_controlled_by = ROOT
	ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active } }
	NOT = { air_winter_response_is_priority_target = yes }
}

		check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@dam value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO compare = greater_than }
		check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@dam_mountain value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO compare = greater_than }
		check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@cataract_dam_mountain value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO compare = greater_than }
	}
}

		}
	}

# Supported scope: STATE. count_triggers amount is a documented structural
# integer field, so file-local preprocessing values are used instead of shared
# script constants.
air_winter_event_has_exactly_one_phase_1_branch = {
	count_triggers = {
		amount = @AIR_WINTER_PHASE_1_BRANCH_MINIMUM
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_boreal_shifts
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_boreal_full
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_maritime_warehouses
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_maritime_shipyards
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_arid_cisterns
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_arid_fountains
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_tropical_drainage
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_tropical_schools
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_highland_markers
		has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_highland_recall
	}
	NOT = {
		count_triggers = {
			amount = @AIR_WINTER_PHASE_1_BRANCH_MALFORMED
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_boreal_shifts
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_boreal_full
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_maritime_warehouses
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_maritime_shipyards
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_arid_cisterns
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_arid_fountains
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_tropical_drainage
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_tropical_schools
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_highland_markers
			has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_1_chain_highland_recall
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The five factory partitions exactly cover a combined
# operational military and civilian factory total of four or more.
air_winter_event_is_heavy_industry_state = {
	OR = {
		coal > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero
		non_damaged_building_level = { building = arms_factory level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.three }
		AND = {
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = arms_factory level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.two }
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = industrial_complex level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		AND = {
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = arms_factory level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = industrial_complex level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
		}
		AND = {
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = arms_factory level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
			non_damaged_building_level = { building = industrial_complex level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.two }
		}
		non_damaged_building_level = { building = industrial_complex level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.three }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_event_is_reactor_state = {
	OR = {
		non_damaged_building_level = { building = nuclear_reactor level > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		non_damaged_building_level = { building = nuclear_reactor_heavy_water level > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		non_damaged_building_level = { building = commercial_nuclear_reactor level > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Unlike response projects, designation may select a
# clear state because a reception state is expected to be safer than its source.
air_winter_response_reception_state_is_available = {
	air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
	NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active }
	ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active } }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_cooldown }
		NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown > @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_has_valid_reception_state = {
	any_controlled_state = {
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		air_winter_response_is_designated_reception_state = yes
		is_in_array = {
			array = ROOT.air_winter_reception_states
			value = THIS
		}
		air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_has_valid_priority_state = {
	has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state
	var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		air_winter_is_active = yes
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		is_controlled_by = ROOT
		air_winter_response_is_priority_target = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_response_controlled_evacuation_quote_is_valid = {
	has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
	var:air_winter_response_priority_owner = {
		has_country_flag = air_winter_evacuation_cache_valid
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_state
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id
		has_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_k
		has_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_people
		has_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_state
			value = PREV.id
			compare = equals
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id
			value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			compare = equals
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_people
			value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO
			compare = greater_than
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after
			value = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_pressure_ceiling
			compare = less_than_or_equals
		}
		var:air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state = {
			is_owned_by = PREV
			is_controlled_by = PREV
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
			has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_response_reception_owner
				value = PREV
				compare = equals
			}
			is_in_array = {
				array = PREV.air_winter_reception_states
				value = THIS
			}
			air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
			NOT = { state = PREV.PREV }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-Fallout response decision gates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the selected source STATE.
air_winter_has_valid_different_reception_state = {
	any_controlled_state = {
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		is_in_array = {
			array = ROOT.air_winter_reception_states
			value = THIS
		}
		air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
		NOT = { state = FROM }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the active controlled evacuation
# source state. The receiver remains locked to the paid project quote.
air_winter_response_controlled_evacuation_project_is_valid = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	FROM = {
		has_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
		has_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_project
		has_state_flag = air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_locked
		has_variable = air_winter_response_project_owner
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_response_project_owner
			value = ROOT
			compare = equals
		}
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		is_controlled_by = ROOT
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people
			value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO
			compare = greater_than
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = state_population_k
			value = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
		var:air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = {
			is_owned_by = ROOT
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
			has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_response_reception_owner
				value = ROOT
				compare = equals
			}
			is_in_array = {
				array = ROOT.air_winter_reception_states
				value = THIS
			}
			air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
			NOT = { state = PREV }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_refugee_pressure
				value = PREV.air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the active final evacuation source.
air_winter_response_final_evacuation_project_is_valid = {

		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain
		has_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people
			value = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_RUNTIME_ZERO
			compare = greater_than
		}
		check_variable = {
			var = state_population_k
			value = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
		var:air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = {
			is_owned_by = ROOT
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
			has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_response_reception_owner
				value = ROOT
				compare = equals
			}
			is_in_array = {
				array = ROOT.air_winter_reception_states
				value = THIS
			}
			air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
			NOT = { state = PREV }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_refugee_pressure
				value = PREV.air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Air Winter event-chain safety

# Supported scope: ANY. The scheduler snapshots the documented read-only
# global.year value once at the start of the open monthly cycle.
air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = {
	has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
	has_variable = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year
	check_variable = { global.air_winter_event_cycle_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
	check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. A source remains live only while its current owner
# also controls the coast and the protected population remainder is intact.
air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_is_live = {
	air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
	has_state_flag = air_winter_initialized
	has_variable = air_winter_phase
	is_owned_and_controlled_by = OWNER
	is_coastal = yes
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_phase
		value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_phase
		value = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	state_population > constant:air_winter_event_island_refugee.protected_source_remainder
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The receipt belongs to a source owner and remains
# current only during the monthly cycle that produced it.
air_winter_island_refugee_source_receipt_is_current = {
	air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = yes
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_region
	check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id
		value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_region
		value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	var:air_winter_island_refugee_source_state = {
		air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_is_live = yes
		is_owned_by = PREV
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_presentation_class
			value = PREV.air_winter_island_refugee_source_region
			compare = equals
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the receiver. The opening event can execute
# only while every frozen scope and monthly-cycle field still matches live data.
air_winter_island_refugee_offer_is_valid = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
	has_variable = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year
	check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { global.air_winter_event_cycle_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	has_country_flag = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_pending
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_state
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_country
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_destination_state
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_year
	has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_cycle_id
	has_event_target = air_winter_event_country
	has_event_target = air_winter_event_state
	has_event_target = air_winter_refugee_source_country
	has_event_target = air_winter_refugee_source_state
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_state
		value = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_country
		value = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_destination_state
		value = event_target:air_winter_event_state
		compare = equals
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family
				value = constant:air_winter_event_family.ordinary_phase
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_year
				value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family
				value = constant:air_winter_event_family.first_frost
				compare = equals
			}
			event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_first_frost_marker
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_score
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id
				has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id
					value = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype
					value = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year
					value = ROOT.air_winter_island_refugee_offer_year
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year
					value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id
					value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
					value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
					value = air_winter_presentation_class
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
					value = ROOT
					compare = equals
				}
				is_owned_by = var:air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
				ROOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_event_year }
						check_variable = {
							var = air_winter_first_frost_event_year
							value = PREV.air_winter_first_frost_origin_year
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_cycle_id
		value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region
		value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	event_target:air_winter_event_country = {
		exists = yes
		tag = ROOT
	}
	event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes
		air_winter_event_is_engine_island_state = yes
	}
	event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country = {
		exists = yes
		NOT = { tag = ROOT }
	}
	event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state = {
		air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_is_live = yes
		is_owned_by = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_presentation_class
			value = ROOT.air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region
			compare = equals
		}
	}
}

	has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_score
	has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id
	has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype
	check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id
		value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
		value = air_winter_presentation_class
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = {
		var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
		value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype value = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype value = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.maximum compare = less_than_or_equals }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_food }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_city }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_coast }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_highland }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_mountain_capital }
				check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
			check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.desert_city }
		}
	}
	is_owned_by = var:air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
	OWNER = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_event_year }
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_event_year value = PREV.air_winter_first_frost_origin_year compare = less_than }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The country region year is seeded on the first

		}
		AND = {
			air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes

		}

	check_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region value = air_winter_presentation_class compare = equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_6_terminal }
	is_owned_by = var:air_winter_terminal_season_origin_owner
	OWNER = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_terminal_season_event_year }
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_event_year value = PREV.air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year compare = less_than }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the final fail-closed dispatch receipt
# contract. Seasonal rows must still match every field frozen on their state.
air_winter_event_candidate_is_dispatchable = {
	air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = yes
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_state
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_id
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_score
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_family
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_priority
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_year
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_region
	has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id
	air_winter_event_candidate_has_valid_route_subtype = yes
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id > constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority > constant:air_winter_event_priority.none }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = less_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_region value = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum compare = less_than_or_equals }
	var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		is_owned_by = PREV
		check_variable = { var = air_winter_presentation_class value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ordinary_phase }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.ordinary_phase }
			air_winter_event_candidate_is_ordinary_phase = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.recovery }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.recovery }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.recovery }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_event_count }
				check_variable = { air_winter_recovery_event_count < constant:air_winter_event_runtime.recovery_arc_cap }
			}
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = air_winter_previous_phase compare = less_than }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.first_frost }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.first_frost }
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				air_winter_first_frost_marker_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_year compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_score value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype compare = equals }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.dark_harvest }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.dark_harvest }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_4_food }
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				air_winter_dark_harvest_marker_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_year value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_year compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_cycle_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_region value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_score value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ash_thaw }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.ash_thaw }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.recovery }
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				air_winter_ash_thaw_marker_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_year value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_year compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_cycle_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_region value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_score value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.second_winter }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.second_winter }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.second_winter }
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				air_winter_second_winter_marker_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_second_winter_origin_year value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_year compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_second_winter_origin_cycle_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_second_winter_origin_region value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_second_winter_origin_score value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.terminal_season }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.terminal_season }
			check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_6_terminal }
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
				air_winter_terminal_season_marker_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_year compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_cycle_id value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_region compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_score value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Both regular targets are saved by the scheduler.
air_winter_event_targets_are_valid = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
	has_event_target = air_winter_event_state
	has_event_target = air_winter_event_country
	event_target:air_winter_event_country = {
		exists = yes
		tag = ROOT
	}
	event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
		air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
		is_owned_by = event_target:air_winter_event_country
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result }
			AND = {
				has_variable = air_winter_pending_event_owner
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_pending_event_owner
					value = event_target:air_winter_event_country
					compare = equals
				}
				air_winter_event_pending_owner_is_valid = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A Phase 1 opening must never adopt or overlap an
# existing delayed-result transaction in the selected state.
air_winter_event_phase_1_opening_targets_are_valid = {
	air_winter_event_targets_are_valid = yes
	event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
		NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result }
		NOT = { air_winter_event_has_pending_chain = yes }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_event_phase_1_result_targets_are_valid = {
	air_winter_event_targets_are_valid = yes
	event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
		has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result
		has_variable = air_winter_pending_event_owner
		check_variable = {
			var = air_winter_pending_event_owner
			value = event_target:air_winter_event_country
			compare = equals
		}
		air_winter_event_pending_owner_is_valid = yes
		air_winter_event_has_exactly_one_phase_1_branch = yes
	}

# Supported scope: STATE. This durable row binds the replayed preflight to the

# population transaction.

	fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_is_current = yes
	has_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_current
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_k
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_people
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_loss_people
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_after_people
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_frozen_current_people
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_target_survivors
	has_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_requested_loss
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_k value = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_k compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_people value = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_loss_people value = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_after_people value = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_requested_loss value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_target_survivors value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO compare = greater_than_or_equals }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. This validates the complete structural
# payload without reading the global transition error ledger. Exact recovery
# uses it before clearing the error that owns the failed identity transaction.
fallout_survival_ledger_identity_payload_structure_is_current = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
		has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged
	}
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_schema
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_country_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_state_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_date
	has_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_day
	check_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_schema value = global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_generation value = global.fallout_successor_allocation_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_country_count value = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_country_count compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries^num compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_state_count value = global.fallout_successor_inventory_state_count compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_count value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_state_count compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_count value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states^num compare = equals }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_date value = global.date compare = greater_than } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
	fallout_successor_allocation_structure_is_current = yes
	fallout_survival_ledger_identity_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	all_of = {
		array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_index_entries
		value = fallout_survival_stored_country_index
		index = fallout_survival_country_payload_index
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_context_loaded = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_stored_country_index value = fallout_survival_country_payload_index compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_generation_entries^fallout_survival_country_payload_index value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals }
		var:global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries^fallout_survival_country_payload_index = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_country_index value = fallout_survival_country_payload_index compare = equals }
			fallout_survival_country_identity_row_is_current = yes
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	all_of = {
		array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries
		value = fallout_survival_source_country
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_source_country_context_loaded = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		var:fallout_survival_source_country = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_source_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries value = THIS }
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_survival_source_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	all_of = {
		array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_index_entries
		value = fallout_survival_stored_state_index
		index = fallout_survival_state_payload_index
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_context_loaded = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_stored_state_index value = fallout_survival_state_payload_index compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_generation_entries^fallout_survival_state_payload_index value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals }
		var:global.fallout_survival_ledger_states^fallout_survival_state_payload_index = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_index value = fallout_survival_state_payload_index compare = equals }
			fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states value = THIS } }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_survival_country_identity_staged
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries value = THIS } }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_survival_state_identity_staged
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states value = THIS } }
		}
	}
}

		check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.not_applicable }

	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_factor > constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_maximum } }

		NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_state_supply_access } }
	}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. The count is a human-reviewed receipt,
# not a count inferred from authored reservations or generated drafts.
fallout_event_release_floor_receipt_is_current = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_event_release_floor_review_complete
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_release_audit_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_release_review_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_release_review_date
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_release_review_day
	check_variable = {
		global.fallout_event_release_audit_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_release_audit_schema.version
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_release_review_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count
		value = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.minimum_reviewed_blocks
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_release_review_date
			value = global.date
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_release_review_day
			value = global.num_days
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
}

		value = global.fallout_transition_generation

	}

	has_variable = global.fallout_event_timeline_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_date
