	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_timeline_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_date
			value = global.date
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day
			value = global.num_days
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_event_timeline_phase_receipt_is_current = {
	fallout_event_map_return_receipts_are_current = yes
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_current_phase
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_phase_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_phase_last_update_day
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_phase_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_phase_last_update_day
		value = global.num_days
		compare = equals
	}
	NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days < constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase > constant:fallout_event_phase.none }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase < constant:fallout_event_phase.upper_bound }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.ash_week }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.ash_week_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.first_season }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.ash_week_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.first_season_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.first_winter_year }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.first_season_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.first_winter_year_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.consolidation }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.first_winter_year_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.consolidation_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.rival_orders }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.consolidation_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.rival_orders_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.new_states }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.rival_orders_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.new_states_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.soot_retreat }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.new_states_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.soot_retreat_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.second_world }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.soot_retreat_end_days }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.second_world_end_days } }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_current_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.open_continuation }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_elapsed_days > constant:fallout_event_timeline.second_world_end_days }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_event_registry_arrays_are_aligned = {
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_countries^num
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation_entries^num
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_countries^num
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_index_entries^num
		compare = equals
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This proves only the frozen registry identity.
# Runtime ledger consistency is layered by the full row trigger below.
fallout_event_registry_country_identity_is_current = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_registry_member
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_runtime_initialized
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_count
	has_variable = fallout_event_registry_generation
	has_variable = fallout_event_registry_index
	has_variable = fallout_event_runtime_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_registry_generation
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_runtime_generation
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_registry_index < constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index } }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_registry_index
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_count
		compare = less_than
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_back_reference_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_registry_index = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_back_reference_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		tag = PREV
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_event_registry_back_reference_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_generation_entries^fallout_event_registry_index
		value = fallout_event_registry_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_registry_index
		value = fallout_event_registry_index
		compare = equals
	}
	fallout_event_registry_arrays_are_aligned = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The scheduler and survival ledgers are frozen from

		var = fallout_survival_country_source_allocation_schema

	}

		var = fallout_survival_country_source_allocation_generation

		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_survival_country_index
		value = fallout_event_registry_index

	}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The stored index must resolve back to this exact

	fallout_event_country_runtime_row_is_current = yes

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The global receipt proves that every frozen
# registry row either initialized or backward-compatibly promoted the empty
# ordinary opening schema for this generation.
fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_header_is_current = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_ready
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_day
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_generation value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This validates the constant-cost header shared by
# uncommitted payload validation and bounded country eligibility checks.
fallout_event_registry_header_payload_is_current = {
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_source_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_schema
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_country_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_cursor
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_initialized_date
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_initialized_day
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_ticket_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_next_ticket_id
	fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_header_is_current = yes
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_schema.version }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_registry_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_registry_schema.version }
	fallout_survival_ledger_header_is_current = yes
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_schema value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_schema_version compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_generation value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_survival_country_count value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count compare = equals }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_ticket_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_next_ticket_id > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_registry_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_count
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_source_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_count
		value = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_count
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_countries^num
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_source_count
		value = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries^num
		compare = equals
	}
	NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_registry_cursor < constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index } }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_event_registry_cursor
		value = global.fallout_event_registry_count
		compare = less_than
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_registry_initialized_date
			value = global.date
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = global.fallout_event_registry_initialized_day
			value = global.num_days
			compare = greater_than
		}
	}
	fallout_event_registry_arrays_are_aligned = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This validates the complete uncommitted payload
# before the ready flag is written. Initial registry equality is frozen from
# the final allocation array. Later annexation does not delete the identity row.
fallout_event_registry_payload_is_current = {
	fallout_event_registry_header_payload_is_current = yes
	all_of = {
		array = global.fallout_event_registry_index_entries
		value = fallout_event_registry_stored_index
		index = fallout_event_registry_payload_index
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_payload_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		check_variable = {
			var = fallout_event_registry_stored_index
			value = fallout_event_registry_payload_index
			compare = equals
		}
		var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_registry_payload_index = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_payload_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_event_registry_index
				value = fallout_event_registry_payload_index
				compare = equals
			}
			is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS }
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_event_registry_payload_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	all_of = {
		array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries
		value = fallout_event_registry_source_country
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_source_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_registry_source_country = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_registry_source_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_event_registry_countries value = THIS }
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_event_registry_source_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Pending rows may hold any exact subset of the five
# receipts. A flag without its generation, or a generation without its flag,
# invalidates the row.
fallout_event_orientation_receipts_are_consistent = {
	has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_status
	OR = {
		fallout_event_orientation_is_complete = yes
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_orientation_status = constant:fallout_event_orientation_status.pending }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_complete }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_generation }
			OR = {
				fallout_event_orientation_national_receipt_is_current = yes
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_national_complete }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_national_generation }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				fallout_event_orientation_capital_receipt_is_current = yes
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_capital_complete }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_capital_generation }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				fallout_event_orientation_resource_receipt_is_current = yes
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_resource_complete }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_resource_generation }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				fallout_event_orientation_archetype_receipt_is_current = yes
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_archetype_complete }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_archetype_generation }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				fallout_event_orientation_character_receipt_is_current = yes
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_orientation_character_complete }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_orientation_character_generation }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Inputs: fallout_event_subject_type_to_check and
# fallout_event_subject_value_to_check. This proves only the stored type/value
# shape. Live actor and target validity is checked separately for cancellation.
fallout_event_subject_shape_is_valid = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check < constant:fallout_event_subject_type.upper_bound }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Inputs are the same as the shape trigger.
fallout_event_subject_is_current = {
	fallout_event_subject_shape_is_valid = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.country }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			var:fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				exists = yes
				fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_country_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			var:fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				has_variable = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.character }
			has_character = var:fallout_event_subject_value_to_check
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.institution }
			# No generic engine liveness surface exists for an opaque institution
			# token. Future content must add a generation-bound registry first.
			always = no
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. One fixed receipt owns at most one ordinary event
# opening. The pending flag is the commit marker and is written only after all
# immutable payload fields exist. The receipt is separate from major arcs and
# does not consume one of their three slots.
fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_is_consistent = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema.version }

			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_generation }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_branch }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_registry_index }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_phase }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_class }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_candidate_id }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_score }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_parent_arc_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_route }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_generation
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_branch
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_registry_index
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_phase
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_class
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_candidate_id
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_score
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_parent_arc_ticket
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_route
			has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema.version }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket value = global.fallout_event_next_ticket_id compare = less_than }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token value = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token compare = equals } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_branch > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day value = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day compare = less_than } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_registry_index value = fallout_event_registry_index compare = equals }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day value = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day compare = less_than } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day value = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family > constant:fallout_event_primary_family.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family < constant:fallout_event_primary_family.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family > constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family < constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_phase > constant:fallout_event_phase.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_phase < constant:fallout_event_phase.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class > constant:fallout_event_class.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class < constant:fallout_event_class.upper_bound }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.crisis_incident }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.major_arc }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.routine_incident }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.broadcast }
			}
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode < constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.none } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode < constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used < constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.upper_bound }
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used < constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.none } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_candidate_id > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_score > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost > constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_visible_budget_cost } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
					fallout_event_partner_registry_index_is_current = yes
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_class = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship } }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
				}
			}
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_parent_arc_ticket < constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_actor > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_ordinary_actor }
					fallout_event_subject_shape_is_valid = yes
				}
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type < constant:fallout_event_subject_type.upper_bound }
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable < constant:fallout_event_repeatability.nonrepeatable } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable < constant:fallout_event_repeatability.upper_bound }
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_route < constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
			}
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket } }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_delayed_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket } }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket } }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_delayed_key_entries value = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key } }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_bilateral_key_entries value = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_ordinary_target }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				}
				fallout_event_subject_shape_is_valid = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. An empty schema-v1 receipt is migratable only when
# every v1 payload field is absent. Pending/nonempty v1 rows are fail-closed.
fallout_event_empty_ordinary_receipt_v1_can_migrate = {
	has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version
	check_variable = { fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema.previous_empty_version }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_generation }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_branch }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_registry_index }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_phase }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_class }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_candidate_id }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_score }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_parent_arc_ticket }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_route }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Runtime rows created before the fixed ordinary
# receipt existed can promote only an exactly absent receipt or the empty v1
# schema above while production remains disabled.
fallout_event_empty_ordinary_receipt_can_promote = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_registry_member
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_runtime_initialized
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_activation_approved }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_active }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_schema_version }
		fallout_event_empty_ordinary_receipt_v1_can_migrate = yes
	}
	NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_generation }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_branch }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_due_day }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_registry_index }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_issue_day }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_primary_family }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_family }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_target }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_phase }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_class }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_mode }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_crisis_break_used }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_candidate_id }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_score }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_visible_budget_cost }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_partner_registry_index }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_parent_arc_ticket }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor_type }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_actor }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_repeatable }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_route }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode }
	has_variable = fallout_event_runtime_schema_version
	has_variable = fallout_event_runtime_generation
	check_variable = { fallout_event_runtime_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_schema.version }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_runtime_generation value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. A registry that already advertised the
# v1 receipt header may only be re-promoted when every current country is empty
# (v1 or v2). Pending/nonempty rows are never rewritten or discarded.
fallout_event_old_ready_empty_ordinary_receipts_can_repromote = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_ready
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_activation_approved }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_error }
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_registry_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_generation
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_registry_generation value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_event_registry_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_count value = global.fallout_event_registry_index_entries^num compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_count value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation_entries^num compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_count value = global.fallout_event_registry_countries^num compare = equals }
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_event_registry_countries
		has_country_flag = fallout_event_registry_member
		has_country_flag = fallout_event_runtime_initialized
		has_variable = fallout_event_registry_index
		check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_registry_index value = fallout_event_registry_index compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = global.fallout_event_registry_generation_entries^fallout_event_registry_index value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
		OR = {
			fallout_event_empty_ordinary_receipt_v1_can_migrate = yes
			AND = {
				fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_is_consistent = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: requested transaction key. Compact queue
# producers use this before appending so a pending ordinary opening keeps sole
# ownership of its stable request identity.
fallout_event_requested_key_differs_from_ordinary_receipt = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending }
		NOT = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_event_requested_transaction_key
				value = fallout_event_ordinary_transaction_key
				compare = equals
			}
		}
	}
}

# Content-owned callback chains keep their resolved result row until the
# callback cleanup has been authenticated. The generic reconciler calls this
# only while a resolved row is selected, so the token check cannot hold an
# unrelated delayed result.
fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_is_deferred = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_reconciled_delayed_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.resolved }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.last_inventory_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_crew_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.animal_feed_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_scheduled
			check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_id.triage_wall_cleanup }
		}
	}
}

# Inputs are the family-specific validation indexes. Each selected identity is
# compared with every compact row. The same physical index is the only allowed
# equality, which makes lookup results authoritative.
fallout_event_arc_row_identity_is_unique = {
	NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_delayed_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_arc_validation_index } }
	NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_arc_validation_index } }
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries
		value = fallout_event_unique_stored_ticket
		index = fallout_event_unique_stored_index
		OR = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_unique_stored_index value = fallout_event_arc_validation_index compare = equals }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_unique_stored_ticket value = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_arc_validation_index compare = equals } }
		}
	}
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_arc_identity_entries
		value = fallout_event_unique_stored_identity
		index = fallout_event_unique_stored_index
		OR = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_unique_stored_index value = fallout_event_arc_validation_index compare = equals }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_unique_stored_identity value = fallout_event_arc_identity_entries^fallout_event_arc_validation_index compare = equals } }
		}
	}
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_arc_actor_entries

					}
					check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	fallout_event_bilateral_row_identity_is_unique = yes

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_cancellation_to_check = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_origin_registry_index = fallout_event_registry_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_bilateral_partner_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		exists = yes
		fallout_event_registry_country_identity_is_current = yes
		fallout_event_bilateral_receipts_are_current = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_match_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
		any_of = {
			array = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries
			value = fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_ticket
			index = fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_back_pointer_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_ticket value = fallout_event_reciprocal_ticket_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_key_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_key_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_generation_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_generation_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_due_date_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_due_day_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_status_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_parent_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_parent_arc_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_cleanup_token_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_outcome_to_check compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_cancellation_to_check compare = equals }
			OR = {
				AND = {

					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_reciprocal_cleanup_owner_to_check value = fallout_event_reciprocal_origin_registry_index compare = equals }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.responder }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_owner_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_reciprocal_origin_registry_index compare = equals }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_role_to_check = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.responder }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_reciprocal_cleanup_owner_to_check value = fallout_event_registry_index compare = equals }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.initiator }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_owner_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index value = fallout_event_registry_index compare = equals }
				}
			}
			var:fallout_event_bilateral_partner_entries^fallout_event_reciprocal_stored_index = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_back_pointer_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

	check_variable = { fallout_event_reciprocal_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = fallout_event_reciprocal_origin_row_index }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_absent = {
	NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_branch }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_date }
	NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_day }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This proves the exact immutable envelope identity
# whose dynamic country_event command has already been issued.
fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_current = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_source
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_generation
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_mode
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_branch
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_branch
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_date
	has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_day
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source value = fallout_event_dispatch_source compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket value = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = fallout_event_dispatch_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_branch value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type value = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target value = fallout_event_dispatch_target compare = equals }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_date value = global.date compare = greater_than } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_day value = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day compare = less_than } }
}

fallout_event_dispatch_envelope_is_consistent = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_source }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_generation }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_mode }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_branch }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target }
			fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_absent = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_source
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_generation
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_mode
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_branch
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_target
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source > constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source < constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode > constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode < constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_branch > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_dispatch_target }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				}
				fallout_event_subject_shape_is_valid = yes
			}
			OR = {
				fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_absent = yes
				fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_current = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A committed envelope must still name the exact
# compact transaction row and the token appropriate to its routing mode.
fallout_event_dispatch_envelope_matches_transaction = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready }
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_pending
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.ordinary_event }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_ticket value = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_generation value = fallout_event_dispatch_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_branch value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_target_type value = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_target value = fallout_event_dispatch_target compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_control_mode value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_human_event_token value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_ordinary_ai_event_token value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
				}
			}
			fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_is_consistent = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
			any_of = {
				array = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries
				value = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_ticket
				index = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_ticket value = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_arc_generation_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_generation compare = equals }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_stage_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.opening }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_identity_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.year_zero_candidate_id }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_human }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_ai }
							}
						}
						has_variable = fallout_event_401_candidate_state_id
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_target value = fallout_event_401_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_identity_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.orchard_flowers_candidate_id }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.orchard_flowers_human }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.orchard_flowers_ai }
							}
						}
						has_variable = fallout_event_408_candidate_state_id
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_target value = fallout_event_408_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_identity_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.skilled_list_candidate_id }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_human }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_ai }
							}
						}
						has_variable = fallout_event_429_candidate_state_id
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_target value = fallout_event_429_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_identity_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.false_spring_losses_candidate_id }
						OR = {

								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.false_spring_losses_human }
							}

								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.false_spring_losses_ai }
							}

						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_target value = fallout_event_478_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_branch = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_target > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_index = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

				array = fallout_event_delayed_ticket_entries

				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_generation_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_generation compare = equals }

						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }

						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.callback_scheduled }
						}
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_human_event_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_branch_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_control_mode_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.callback_scheduled }
						}
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_ai_event_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_branch_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_cleanup }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.cleanup_pending }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_branch_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
					}
				}
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_target_type_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_target_type compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_delayed_target_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_target compare = equals }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_index = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_validation_index = fallout_event_dispatch_match_index }
			fallout_event_delayed_row_at_index_is_structurally_current = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.bilateral_response }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.country }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
			any_of = {
				array = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries
				value = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_ticket
				index = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_ticket value = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_generation_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_generation compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_branch compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_partner_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_target compare = equals }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_control_mode_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.responder }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_response_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_control_mode_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.responder }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_ai_response_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.human_visible }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_control_mode_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.reserved }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.initiator }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_response_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_human }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token value = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_human compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_control_mode_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_mode compare = equals }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.reserved }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.initiator }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_ai_response_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_ai }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token value = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_ai compare = equals }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_cleanup }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index value = fallout_event_dispatch_event_token compare = equals }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_index = fallout_event_dispatch_stored_index }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_match_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = fallout_event_dispatch_match_index }
			fallout_event_bilateral_row_at_index_is_structurally_current = yes
		}
	}

				value = fallout_event_stored_cleanup_stage

					value = fallout_event_stored_cleanup_stage
					check_variable = { fallout_event_stored_cleanup_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {

			any_of = {
				array = fallout_event_delayed_status_entries
				value = fallout_event_stored_cleanup_status
				check_variable = { fallout_event_stored_cleanup_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.cleanup_pending }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_delayed_cleanup_pending }
			NOT = {
				any_of = {
					array = fallout_event_delayed_status_entries
					value = fallout_event_stored_cleanup_status

			}
		}
	}
	OR = {

				value = fallout_event_stored_cleanup_status

fallout_event_transaction_history_receipts_are_consistent = {
	has_variable = fallout_event_cancellation_count
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_cancellation_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_cancellation_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancelled_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_source }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_reason }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_generation }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_day }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_cancellation_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancelled_ticket
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_source
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_reason
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_generation
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_cancellation_day
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cancelled_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cancellation_source > constant:fallout_event_transaction_source.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cancellation_source < constant:fallout_event_transaction_source.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cancellation_reason > constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cancellation_reason < constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_last_cancellation_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_last_cancellation_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_generation }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_day }
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_generation
			has_variable = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_day
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_last_transaction_reconcile_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migrated
			has_variable = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_generation
			has_variable = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_day
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migrated }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_generation }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_transaction_schema_migration_day }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. New visible and AI work requires the full production
# gate. Exact hidden-cleanup envelopes remain issuable after deactivation so
# already committed rows can finish their content-owned cleanup.
fallout_event_dispatch_issuance_is_approved = {
	exists = yes
	fallout_event_registry_header_is_current = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_error }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_mode
			check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_cleanup }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_activation_approved
			has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_active
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: requested parent arc ticket. Ticket zero is
# the explicit no-parent value. A non-zero parent must be unique, current,
# live, and still before cleanup.
fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_is_current = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		any_of = {
			array = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries
			value = fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_ticket
			index = fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_index
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_ticket value = fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket compare = equals }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_arc_validation_index = fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_index }
			fallout_event_arc_row_at_index_is_structurally_current = yes
			check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_stage_entries^fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_index < constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_arc_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_index }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_arc_actor_entries^fallout_event_parent_arc_stored_index }
			fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Mutable liveness and not-in-the-past checks apply
# only when a delayed row is first created. An exact key retry is authenticated
# from its stored row and does not become false merely because time advanced.
fallout_event_requested_delayed_new_row_inputs_are_current = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_due_lower_bound = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_due_lower_bound = constant:fallout_event_runtime.minimum_due_delay_days }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_due_upper_bound = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_due_upper_bound = constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_due_delay_days }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_requested_due_day value = fallout_event_due_lower_bound compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_requested_due_day value = fallout_event_due_upper_bound compare = greater_than } }
	fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_is_current = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_requested_target_type }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_requested_target }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The reciprocal countries are validated by the

fallout_event_requested_bilateral_new_row_inputs_are_current = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_due_lower_bound = global.num_days }

	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_requested_due_day value = fallout_event_due_upper_bound compare = greater_than } }
	fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_is_current = yes

	check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_target_type < constant:fallout_event_subject_type.upper_bound }
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_target < constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = fallout_event_last_selected_partner_registry_index }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_class = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
			fallout_event_partner_registry_index_is_current = yes
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_class = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_partner_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
		}
	}
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_last_selected_ticket < constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_last_cleanup_ticket < constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_last_cleanup_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_expected_quiet_period_due_day = global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_expected_quiet_period_due_day = constant:fallout_event_runtime.quiet_period_days }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_quiet_period_due_day
		value = fallout_event_expected_quiet_period_due_day
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_family_fatigue_entries^num
		value = constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.upper_bound
		compare = equals
	}
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_family_fatigue_entries
		value = fallout_event_family_fatigue_value
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_family_fatigue_value < constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_family_fatigue_value > constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_fatigue } }
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_event_family_fatigue_entries^0 = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	fallout_event_visible_history_arrays_are_current = yes
	fallout_event_bilateral_memory_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	fallout_event_candidate_registry_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_completion_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_completion_day_entries^num compare = equals }
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_candidate_completion_id_entries
		value = fallout_event_completed_id
		index = fallout_event_completed_index
		check_variable = { fallout_event_completed_id > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_completion_day_entries^fallout_event_completed_index value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
	}
	fallout_event_orientation_receipts_are_consistent = yes
	fallout_event_arc_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	fallout_event_delayed_queue_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	fallout_event_bilateral_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_active_major_arc_count value = fallout_event_arc_ticket_entries^num compare = equals }
	fallout_event_arc_cursor_is_valid = yes
	fallout_event_delayed_cursor_is_valid = yes
	fallout_event_bilateral_cursor_is_valid = yes
	fallout_event_ordinary_receipt_is_consistent = yes
	fallout_event_dispatch_envelope_is_consistent = yes
	fallout_event_dispatch_envelope_matches_transaction = yes
	fallout_event_cleanup_flags_are_consistent = yes
	fallout_event_transaction_history_receipts_are_consistent = yes
	fallout_event_ticket_ledger_is_current = yes
	fallout_event_arc_receipts_are_current = yes
	fallout_event_delayed_queue_receipts_are_current = yes
	fallout_event_bilateral_receipts_are_current = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The caller sets the requested cooldown family in
# the temporary variable named below. Repetition is a hard veto, not a score.
fallout_event_requested_family_differs_from_last = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cooldown_family > constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cooldown_family < constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.upper_bound }
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			var = fallout_event_requested_cooldown_family
			value = fallout_event_last_cooldown_family
			compare = equals
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The caller supplies the candidate or receipt
# partner index in fallout_event_partner_index_to_check. Index -1 is the typed
# no-partner sentinel. A real partner must be a current, distinct registry
# member in the same frozen generation.
fallout_event_partner_registry_index_is_current = {
	NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check < constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index } }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_partner_index_to_check value = global.fallout_event_registry_count compare = less_than }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_partner_index_to_check value = fallout_event_registry_index compare = equals } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		has_country_flag = fallout_event_registry_member
		has_country_flag = fallout_event_runtime_initialized
		has_variable = fallout_event_runtime_schema_version
		has_variable = fallout_event_runtime_generation
		check_variable = { fallout_event_runtime_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_schema.version }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_runtime_generation value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_registry_index value = fallout_event_partner_index_to_check compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_registry_generation value = global.fallout_event_registry_generation compare = equals }
		fallout_event_registry_country_identity_is_current = yes
		fallout_event_registry_country_survival_binding_is_current = yes
		fallout_event_partner_runtime_state_is_current = yes
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_event_partner_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This partner proof deliberately excludes the full
