	check_variable = { fallout_event_runtime_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_schema.version }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_orientation_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_orientation_schema.version }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_arc_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_arc_schema.version }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_queue_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_delayed_queue_schema.version }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The authored relevance column is accepted only
# when it equals the deterministic control relationship: the current human
# recipient is 100 and an authenticated current human bilateral partner is 50.
# The 25-point war/mission target surface remains fail-closed until its exact
# typed relationship receipt exists.
fallout_event_candidate_player_relevance_is_current = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_expected_player_relevance = constant:fallout_event_runtime.player_relevance_none }
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_expected_player_relevance = constant:fallout_event_runtime.player_relevance_human_recipient }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index < constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index < global.fallout_event_registry_count }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
		var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_expected_player_relevance = constant:fallout_event_runtime.player_relevance_human_bilateral_partner }
			}
		}
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_event_candidate_player_relevance_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index
		value = fallout_event_expected_player_relevance
		compare = equals
	}
}

	fallout_event_orientation_is_complete = yes

		value = fallout_event_quiet_period_due_day
		compare = greater_than
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.num_days
		value = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_due_day
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	any_owned_state = { always = yes }

}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This validates the four fixed-size history arrays
# without consulting live ownership or the survival ledger.
fallout_event_visible_history_arrays_are_current = {
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_type_entries^num value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.visible_history_size compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_entries^num value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.visible_history_size compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_day_entries^num value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.visible_history_size compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_event_entries^num value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.visible_history_size compare = equals }
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_visible_target_type_entries
		value = fallout_event_visible_history_type
		index = fallout_event_visible_history_index
		check_variable = { fallout_event_visible_history_type < constant:fallout_event_subject_type.upper_bound }
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_visible_history_type < constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none } }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_visible_history_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_entries^fallout_event_visible_history_index value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_event_entries^fallout_event_visible_history_index value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
			}
			AND = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_visible_history_type > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_entries^fallout_event_visible_history_index value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_event_entries^fallout_event_visible_history_index value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
			}
		}
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_day_entries^fallout_event_visible_history_index value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Bilateral pair/family memory retains only durable
# scheduler receipts. Eligibility applies the rolling 90-day window.
fallout_event_bilateral_memory_arrays_are_aligned = {
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner_entries^num value = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_family_entries^num compare = equals }
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner_entries^num value = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_day_entries^num compare = equals }
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner_entries
		value = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner
		index = fallout_event_bilateral_memory_index
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner < constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index } }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_memory_partner < global.fallout_event_registry_count }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_memory_family_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_memory_index > constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.none }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_memory_family_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_memory_index < constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.upper_bound }
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_memory_day_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_memory_index > global.num_days } }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the scheduler-owned frozen size proof.
# It intentionally never rechecks num_owned_states or a live survival row.
fallout_event_frozen_country_size_is_current = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_state_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_country_size > constant:fallout_event_country_size.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_country_size < constant:fallout_event_country_size.upper_bound }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_state_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.small_state_upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_country_size = constant:fallout_event_country_size.small }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_state_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.small_state_upper_bound } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_state_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.medium_state_upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_country_size = constant:fallout_event_country_size.medium }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_state_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.medium_state_upper_bound } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_frozen_country_size = constant:fallout_event_country_size.large }
		}
	}
}

			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_government_match_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_government_match_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

		}

	}
	OR = {

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The reviewed producer must bind this row set to
# the same scheduler generation and cannot rely on live ownership currentness.
fallout_event_candidate_registry_is_reviewed = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_event_candidate_registry_reviewed
	has_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation
	has_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_day
	check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_registry_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	fallout_event_candidate_registry_arrays_are_aligned = yes
	all_of = {
		array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
		value = fallout_event_candidate_registry_id
		index = fallout_event_candidate_validation_index
		fallout_event_candidate_row_is_current = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: fallout_event_candidate_validation_index.
# The recurrence exception requires live evidence, not an authored bypass. A
# current capital is proven through the documented state trigger. Active siege
# remains fail-closed until Fallout owns a typed current-siege receipt.
fallout_event_candidate_recurrence_exception_is_current = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_capital_or_siege_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_recurrence_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_recurrence_state_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	var:fallout_event_recurrence_state_to_check = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_recurrence_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		is_capital = yes
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_event_recurrence_state_context_loaded = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
}

fallout_event_numerical_registry_header_is_current = {

	has_global_flag = fallout_event_global_broadcast_receipt_initialized

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: fallout_event_candidate_validation_index.
# This reciprocal proof is intentionally separate from the general row proof.
# It never rewrites a candidate partner index and remains false until both
# candidate registries carry the same generation-bound relationship payload.
fallout_event_candidate_relationship_payload_is_current = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_bilateral_opportunity_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_relationship_source_candidate_id = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_relationship_source_transaction_key = fallout_event_candidate_transaction_key_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_relationship_source_registry_index = fallout_event_registry_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	fallout_event_partner_registry_index_is_current = yes
	var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = {
		has_country_flag = fallout_event_candidate_registry_reviewed
		has_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation
		has_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_day
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals }
		NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_registry_day value = global.num_days compare = greater_than } }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_transaction_key_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_human_event_token_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_ai_event_token_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_visible_budget_cost_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_bilateral_opportunity_entries^num compare = equals }
		check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^num value = fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^num compare = equals }
		any_of = {
			array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
			value = fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_id
			index = fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index
			AND = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_id value = fallout_event_relationship_source_candidate_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_transaction_key_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index value = fallout_event_relationship_source_transaction_key compare = equals }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_bilateral_opportunity_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_human_event_token_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_ai_event_token_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_human_event_token_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index value = fallout_event_candidate_ai_event_token_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index compare = equals } }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_visible_budget_cost_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_visible_budget_cost_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_visible_budget_cost } }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_relationship_partner_candidate_index value = fallout_event_relationship_source_registry_index compare = equals }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: fallout_event_candidate_validation_index.
# A top-level major row can enter the capped arc ledger only after its
# candidate identity and actor or target shape are current. Stage dispatch is
# intentionally owned by a later authored arc consumer.
fallout_event_candidate_major_arc_payload_is_current = {
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.major_arc }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_parent_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_id_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_actor_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: fallout_event_candidate_validation_index.
# This adds live scope checks and scheduler occupancy gates to the immutable
# reviewed-row proof. Any failure rejects only this candidate.
fallout_event_candidate_row_is_eligible = {
	fallout_event_candidate_row_is_current = yes
	fallout_event_candidate_parent_arc_is_current = yes
	fallout_event_candidate_completion_is_compatible = yes
	# Major-arc openings enter only through the top-level arc payload proof.
	# Relationship rows use the reciprocal bilateral payload proof above.
	OR = {
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.crisis_incident }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.routine_incident }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.broadcast }
		fallout_event_candidate_relationship_payload_is_current = yes
		fallout_event_candidate_major_arc_payload_is_current = yes
	}
	OR = {
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.neutral }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = global.fallout_event_current_phase }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.preferred }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_secondary_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = global.fallout_event_current_phase }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.preferred }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.secondary }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.required }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = global.fallout_event_current_phase }
		}
	}
	NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_cooldown_family_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index value = fallout_event_last_cooldown_family compare = equals } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship }
			fallout_event_partner_registry_index_is_current = yes
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship } }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_partner_index_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = fallout_event_candidate_actor_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_value_to_check = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_subject_type_to_check > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			fallout_event_subject_is_current = yes
		}
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.major_arc } }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_parent_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_active_major_arc_count < constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_major_arcs }
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.delayed_result } }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_delayed_ticket_entries^num < constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_delayed_rows }
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.relationship } }
		check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries^num < constant:fallout_event_runtime.maximum_bilateral_rows }
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.broadcast } }
		AND = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_broadcast_due_day = global.fallout_event_last_broadcast_day }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_broadcast_due_day = constant:fallout_event_runtime.broadcast_cooldown_days }
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = fallout_event_broadcast_due_day compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_actor_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_parent_arc_ticket_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			fallout_event_candidate_actor_matches_parent_arc = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
			NOT = {
				any_of = {
					array = fallout_event_arc_actor_entries
					value = fallout_event_reserved_actor
					index = fallout_event_reserved_actor_index
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_arc_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_reserved_actor_index value = fallout_event_candidate_actor_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_reserved_actor value = fallout_event_candidate_actor_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		fallout_event_candidate_recurrence_exception_is_current = yes
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_type_entries^0 value = fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_type_entries^1 value = fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_entries^0 value = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_entries^1 value = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index compare = equals }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_repetition_cutoff_day = global.num_days }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_repetition_cutoff_day = constant:fallout_event_runtime.repetition_state_window_days }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_day_entries^0 value = fallout_event_repetition_cutoff_day compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_visible_target_day_entries^1 value = fallout_event_repetition_cutoff_day compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
	}
	# Resolve the single typed pressure source exactly as the score effect does.
	# A survival source is fail-closed when its current ledger row is absent.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_pressure_source_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.event_owned } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = fallout_event_candidate_mechanic_pressure_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_pressure_source_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.survival_resource }
			fallout_survival_country_resource_row_is_durable = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.resource_pressure_midpoint }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_resource_index = fallout_event_candidate_resource_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_event_candidate_normalized_resource_index }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.resource_pressure_multiplier }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_pressure_source_type_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.air_winter } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_one } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_one } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_two } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_two } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_three } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_three } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_four } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_four } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_five } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_five } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_air_winter_phase_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.phase_six } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase_pressure.phase_six } }
	}
	OR = {
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_crisis_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.none }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_crisis_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.eligible }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.crisis_incident }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_due_day compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_due_day compare = less_than }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_crisis_resource_match_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_resource_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_survival_resource.none }
					fallout_survival_country_resource_row_is_durable = yes
					NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure < constant:fallout_event_runtime.crisis_break_pressure } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_crisis_break_cooldown_day = fallout_event_last_crisis_break_day }
					add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_crisis_break_cooldown_day = constant:fallout_event_runtime.crisis_break_cooldown_days }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_crisis_break_cooldown_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_crisis_popup_gap_day = fallout_event_last_visible_popup_day }
					add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_crisis_popup_gap_day = constant:fallout_event_runtime.crisis_break_gap_days }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_crisis_popup_gap_day value = global.num_days compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_due_day compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_crisis_mode_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.eligible }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.crisis_incident }
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = fallout_event_ordinary_cooldown_due_day compare = less_than }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_crisis_resource_match_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_resource_index_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index > constant:fallout_survival_resource.none }
			fallout_survival_country_resource_row_is_durable = yes
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_normalized_pressure < constant:fallout_event_runtime.crisis_break_pressure } }
		}
		check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_class_entries^fallout_event_candidate_validation_index = constant:fallout_event_class.broadcast }
	}
}

fallout_event_pilot_failed_calculation_state_is_current = {
	is_controlled_by = ROOT
	fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
	fallout_survival_state_resource_row_is_durable = yes
	fallout_state_supply_access_row_is_current = yes

	check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:fallout_event_air_winter_phase.upper_bound compare = less_than }
	has_state_flag = fallout_event_824_memory_closed
	OR = {
		check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@industrial_complex value = constant:fallout_event_831_threshold.minimum_industry compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@arms_factory value = constant:fallout_event_831_threshold.minimum_arms_factory compare = greater_than_or_equals }

		has_country_flag = fallout_event_366_memory_closed
		has_variable = fallout_failed_calculation_calculation_legitimacy_current
		has_variable = fallout_failed_calculation_inquiry_pressure_current
		check_variable = { var = fallout_failed_calculation_calculation_legitimacy_current value = constant:fallout_event_831_threshold.minimum_calculation_legitimacy compare = greater_than_or_equals }

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT FRACTURE TRIGGERS

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Fracture never consumes a human or protected
# package. Every source retains its capital and at least one state. Priority
# selection adds the severe-war memory below, while this general gate ensures
# that Fallout always has a statically valid random-border fallback.
fallout_fracture_source_is_eligible = {
	exists = yes
	is_ai = yes
	has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country
	NOT = { fallout_country_has_live_event_package_ownership = yes }
	num_of_controlled_states > constant:fallout_fracture_contract.minimum_source_states
	any_owned_state = {
		NOT = { is_capital = yes }
		NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_fracture_state_transferred }
		has_variable = fallout_state_grade
		is_controlled_by = PREV
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. War-scarred countries are selected before the
# general fallback when at least one still has a severe non-capital state.
fallout_fracture_priority_source_is_eligible = {
	fallout_fracture_source_is_eligible = yes
	has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_war
	any_owned_state = {
		NOT = { is_capital = yes }
		NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_fracture_state_transferred }
		is_controlled_by = PREV
		check_variable = {
			var = fallout_state_grade
			value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
			compare = greater_than_or_equals
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A live conflict ledger is required before any
# reserved Independence Wave tag may be copied by the dynamic-country effect.
fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_is_current = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_complete
	has_variable = global.fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	has_variable = global.fallout_fracture_safe_template_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_fracture_blocked_template_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_fracture_template_count
	has_variable = global.fallout_fracture_recorded_template_count
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_recorded_template_count
		value = global.fallout_fracture_template_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool^num
		value = global.fallout_fracture_template_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_safe_templates^num
		value = global.fallout_fracture_safe_template_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_blocked_templates^num
		value = global.fallout_fracture_blocked_template_count
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_fracture_safe_template_count
		value = constant:fallout_fracture_contract.zero
		compare = greater_than
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The ledger is built before this trigger is read.
# Dynamic-country creation and child effects are documented engine surfaces,
# so the core fracture no longer depends on an unrelated live-test flag.
fallout_fracture_release_is_enabled = {
	fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_failed }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The border campaign resolves only when the same

fallout_generic_border_campaign_resolved = {

		compare = equals
	}
	var:fallout_generic_border_target_state = {
		is_owned_by = ROOT
		is_controlled_by = ROOT
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Dynamic outputs are created after the frozen world

	exists = yes

	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_fracture_core_count
		value = constant:fallout_runtime.one
		compare = equals
	}
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			fallout_country_has_zombie_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_mengele_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_soviet_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_independence_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_liberation_reservation = yes
			fallout_country_has_holy_realm_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_cannibalism_package_ownership = yes
			fallout_country_has_other_special_package_ownership = yes
		}
	}
	has_variable = fallout_government_origin_archetype
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_fracture_output_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_government_classifier_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_government_classifier_schema_version
		value = constant:fallout_government_classifier_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype > constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype < constant:fallout_government_archetype.upper_bound }
	fallout_country_technology_regression_is_current = yes
	any_owned_state = { fallout_state_can_host_government = yes }
}

	check_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.minimum_state_supply compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	check_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.minimum_state_adaptation compare = greater_than_or_equals }

	check_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_pressure value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.maximum_state_disease compare = less_than }

		check_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_piracy_pressure_current value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.minimum_piracy_pressure compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	}
	NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_event_775_registry_reserved }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_event_775_registry_committed }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_event_775_memory_closed }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_project }
	NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_completed }
}

@FALLOUT_MINE_RESOURCE_PRESENCE_AMOUNT = 0

		has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > @FALLOUT_MINE_RESOURCE_PRESENCE_AMOUNT }
		has_resources_amount = { resource = chromium amount > @FALLOUT_MINE_RESOURCE_PRESENCE_AMOUNT }
		has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > @FALLOUT_MINE_RESOURCE_PRESENCE_AMOUNT }
	}
}

		exists = yes

		fallout_survival_state_resource_row_is_durable = yes

}

	owner = {
		check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_175_cost.minimum_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 < constant:fallout_event_175_threshold.medicine_pressure }
	}
	NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_committed }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_request_ledger_is_free = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY

	has_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator
	tag = event_target:fallout_transition_coordinator
}

	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked }
	fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
	exists = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Automatic air collapse respects the dedicated
# Fallout settings gate and the ordinary world-end disable switch.
fallout_air_request_is_valid = {
	fallout_request_source_is_air = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_disabled }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
		has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_request_paused
	}
	fallout_consequence_enabled = yes
	check_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_bp
		value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.irreversible_100
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Final Silence remains a source-memory identity for
# legacy Holy Realm saves, but its terminal route now hands control to Fallout
# before any generic world-end flag is written.
fallout_final_silence_request_is_valid = {
	fallout_request_source_is_final_silence = yes
	fallout_consequence_enabled = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99 }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_disabled }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence
			has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_completed
		}
	}
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_zombies }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_fury }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_death }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_cannibalism }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_cannibalism_wendigo }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Explicit terminal sources do not require an Air
# Contamination or Chaos threshold, but they cannot replace another terminal.
fallout_explicit_terminal_request_is_valid = {
	OR = {
		fallout_request_source_is_chemical = yes
		fallout_request_source_is_biological = yes
		fallout_request_source_is_mixed = yes
		fallout_request_source_is_strategic_singularity = yes
	}
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_disabled }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The manual scenario is an explicit player action.
# Its own reservation and completed-sweep checks are performed by the caller.
fallout_manual_request_is_valid = {
	fallout_request_source_is_manual = yes
	NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
	has_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_pending_request_is_valid = {
	OR = {
		fallout_air_request_is_valid = yes
		fallout_final_silence_request_is_valid = yes
		fallout_explicit_terminal_request_is_valid = yes
		fallout_manual_request_is_valid = yes
	}
}

}

# Supported scope: STATE. This proof reads only the frozen row. It remains
# valid after Air Winter changes, ownership changes, or the live receipt clears.
fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_is_structurally_current = {
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation
	has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_provenance_recorded
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version
		value = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version
		value = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation
		value = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_provenance_recorded }
		AND = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_provenance_recorded
			has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_generation
				value = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation
				compare = equals
			}
		}
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category
		value = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category
		value = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.clear
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security
				value = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.not_applicable }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.phase }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.exposure }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.recovery }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.adaptation }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.food_reserve }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.shelter_capacity }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.reclamation }
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.water_security }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This capture-only proof binds a produced frozen row
# to the live Air Winter receipt. N/A is accepted only for an invalid state.
fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_matches_capture = {
	fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_is_structurally_current = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced }
			air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_receipt_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version value = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation value = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase value = air_winter_phase compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure value = air_winter_exposure compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery value = air_winter_recovery compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation value = air_winter_adaptation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve value = air_winter_food_reserve compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity value = air_winter_shelter_capacity compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation value = air_winter_reclamation compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security value = air_winter_water_security compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category value = air_winter_original_category compare = equals }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.not_applicable }
			NOT = { air_winter_state_is_valid = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The live transition category is independent from Air
# Winter's historical original-category provenance.
fallout_state_category_matches_frozen_snapshot = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland } has_state_category = wasteland }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave } has_state_category = enclave }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island } has_state_category = tiny_island }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island } has_state_category = small_island }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } has_state_category = pastoral }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } has_state_category = rural }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } has_state_category = town }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } has_state_category = large_town }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } has_state_category = city }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } has_state_category = large_city }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } has_state_category = metropolis }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } has_state_category = megalopolis }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island } has_state_category = large_island }
	}
}

		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_category_conversion_target = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } has_state_category = rural }
		AND = { check_variable = { fallout_category_conversion_target = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } has_state_category = town }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_pretransition_country_snapshot_row_is_current = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_scope
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation
	var:fallout_pretransition_country_scope = { tag = PREV }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation
		value = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries value = THIS }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any
fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = {
	has_variable = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_date
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_request_source
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_request_intensity
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_chaos_meter_value
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_contamination_bp
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_date
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
		value = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_date
		value = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_date
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source > constant:fallout_request_source.none }
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_request_source
		value = constant:fallout_request_source.strategic_singularity
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_request_intensity
		value = constant:fallout_request_intensity.standard
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_request_intensity
		value = constant:fallout_request_intensity.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_chaos_meter_value > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_air_contamination_bp > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_countries^num > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
		fallout_pretransition_country_snapshot_row_is_current = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_postsnapshot_country_count }
			collection_size = {
				input = game:all_countries
				value = global.fallout_pretransition_countries^num
			}
			collection_size = {
				input = {
					input = game:all_countries
					operators = {
						limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries value = THIS } }
					}
				}
				value = global.fallout_pretransition_countries^num
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_postsnapshot_country_count
			collection_size = {
				input = game:all_countries
				value = global.fallout_postsnapshot_country_count
			}
			collection_size = {
				input = {
					input = game:all_countries
					operators = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries value = THIS }
								is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_output_countries value = THIS }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				value = global.fallout_postsnapshot_country_count
			}
		}
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = {
			input = game:all_states
			operators = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_pretransition_state_snapshot_row_is_structurally_current = yes } }
			}
		}
		value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. This stronger proof is used only in the synchronous
# capture transaction. It compares owner, controller, and Air Winter producer
# values to the frozen row before the complete flag can be written.
fallout_world_snapshot_capture_rows_are_current = {
	fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes
	collection_size = {
		input = {
			input = game:all_states
			operators = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_pretransition_state_snapshot_row_is_current = yes } }
			}
		}
	value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. This is the no-delete invariant for original country
# tags. Ownership can change, and a later gated fracture may add dynamic tags,
# but every country that existed in the frozen snapshot must still resolve to
# a live tag before the map is revealed.
fallout_pretransition_tag_rows_exist = {
	has_variable = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_pretransition_countries^num
		value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
		compare = greater_than
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
		exists = yes
	}
}

fallout_pretransition_tags_are_preserved = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_complete
	has_variable = global.fallout_tag_preservation_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_tag_preservation_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	fallout_pretransition_tag_rows_exist = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A rebuild is legal only inside the short pre-lock
# transaction or while an active current-schema transition remains in phase 1.
fallout_snapshot_epoch_rebuild_is_allowed = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_snapshot_applied }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started }
	has_variable = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_transition_phase
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
		value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_phase
		value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot
		compare = equals
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_snapshot_prelock_capture_authorized
			has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Blackout and world-end ownership may be committed
# only after both halves of the shared snapshot epoch pass their full proofs.
fallout_snapshot_epoch_is_ready_to_lock = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_locked }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
	fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
		value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_phase
		value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot
		compare = equals
	}
	has_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
	fallout_player_snapshot_ledger_is_current = yes
	has_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
	fallout_world_snapshot_capture_rows_are_current = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This validates the deterministic grading receipt
# without using the phase-complete flag that the world ledger will set.
fallout_state_grading_components_are_current = {
	fallout_pretransition_state_snapshot_row_is_structurally_current = yes
	has_state_flag = fallout_state_graded
	has_state_flag = fallout_grade_score_reconciled
	has_state_flag = fallout_survival_value_reconciled
	has_variable = fallout_grade_score
	has_variable = fallout_state_grade
	has_variable = fallout_state_grade_date
	has_variable = fallout_state_subtype
	has_variable = fallout_survival_value
	has_variable = fallout_survival_value_date
	check_variable = { fallout_grade_score > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_grade_score
		value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.maximum_score
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_state_grade > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_state_grade
		value = constant:fallout_state_grade.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_survival_value > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_survival_value
		value = constant:fallout_survival_value.maximum
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.remote_refuge }
			check_variable = { fallout_grade_score < constant:fallout_grade_threshold.scarred_province }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.scarred_province }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_grade_score
				value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.scarred_province
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_grade_score < constant:fallout_grade_threshold.ash_zone }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_grade_score
				value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.ash_zone
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_grade_score < constant:fallout_grade_threshold.dead_city }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_grade_score
				value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.dead_city
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_grade_score < constant:fallout_grade_threshold.wasteland }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_grade_score
				value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.wasteland
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_grade_score < constant:fallout_grade_threshold.vitrified_zone }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.vitrified_zone }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_grade_score
				value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.vitrified_zone
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_subtype = constant:fallout_state_subtype.none }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_state_subtype = constant:fallout_state_subtype.altered_biosphere }
			has_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Deaths and state-map totals are observed after the
# population mutation. Zero-loss and registered-loss paths are explicit
# receipts. Fallout registration remains mandatory even when the general
# Deaths setting is disabled.
fallout_population_deaths_accounting_receipt_is_durable = {
	has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_deaths_evaluated
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_before
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_after
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_delta
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_before
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_after
	has_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta
	has_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_before
	has_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_after
	has_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_delta
	check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_before > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_after > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_before > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_after > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_before > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_after > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status = constant:fallout_deaths_accounting_status.zero_loss }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_delta = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_delta = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status = constant:fallout_deaths_accounting_status.registered }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_deaths_total_delta value = fallout_population_loss_memory compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.one }

	check_variable = { fallout_population_available_before_loss > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_expected_loss > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_after_loss_people > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_reconciled_loss > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory > constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_population_expected_loss
		value = fallout_population_loss_requested_memory
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_population_available_before_loss
		value = fallout_population_before_loss_people
		compare = less_than_or_equals
	}

			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_supply_node = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_rail_way = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node value = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way value = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way compare = equals }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_requested_supply_node value = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_requested_rail_way value = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node value = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way value = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way compare = equals }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This proves one human source before any country or
# state mutation. A landless human remains a valid reserved source and must be
# materialized by the successor allocator.
fallout_pretransition_player_snapshot_row_is_current = {
	exists = yes
	is_ai = no
	has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_country
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_scope
	has_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_id
	has_variable = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
	has_variable = fallout_player_continuation_branch
	has_variable = fallout_player_continuation_status
	var:fallout_pretransition_country_scope = { tag = PREV }
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_pretransition_country_id
		value = THIS.id
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
		value = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.snapshotted }
	is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries value = THIS }
	NOT = {
		any_owned_state = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state }
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope }
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_player_origin_id }
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation }
				NOT = { var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV } }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_player_origin_id
						value = THIS.id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_player_origin_generation
						value = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
			has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
			var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
			NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor_preserved
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_source_landless }
			has_variable = fallout_player_source_anchor_state
			var:fallout_player_source_anchor_state = {
				is_owned_by = PREV
				has_state_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor
				has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
				has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
				has_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_player_origin_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
				var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_source_landless
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor_preserved }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_player_source_anchor_state }
			NOT = { any_owned_state = { always = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Exact collection coverage rejects omitted live tags,

		input = game:all_countries
		value = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_count
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = game:all_possible_countries
		value = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scope_count
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = game:all_states
		value = global.fallout_successor_inventory_state_count
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = {
			input = game:all_countries
			operators = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_row_is_current = yes }
						NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries value = THIS } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = {
			input = game:all_possible_countries
			operators = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scopes value = THIS } }
				}
			}
		}
		value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
	collection_size = {
		input = {
			input = game:all_states
			operators = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_successor_state_inventory_row_is_current = yes } }
			}
		}
		value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries
		fallout_live_tag_conflict_row_is_current = yes
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_successor_candidate_states
		fallout_successor_state_inventory_row_is_current = yes
		fallout_successor_state_is_candidate = yes
		NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_player_reserved_states value = THIS } }
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_player_reserved_states
		fallout_successor_state_inventory_row_is_current = yes
		fallout_state_has_current_player_reservation = yes
		NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_candidate_states value = THIS } }
	}
}
