# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Each enum identity has a distinct provenance
# contract. A releasable needs a current release receipt. Dynamic creation
# remains unavailable unless its output was absent from the frozen possible-
# country registry and owns a current materialization receipt.
fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_provenance_is_current = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.continued_in_place }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = { tag = PREV }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.converted_existing }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = {
				tag = PREV
				has_country_flag = fallout_existing_tag_conversion_committed
				has_variable = fallout_existing_tag_conversion_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_existing_tag_conversion_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.released_releasable }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = {
				is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scopes value = THIS }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries value = THIS } }
				has_country_flag = fallout_releasable_release_committed
				has_variable = fallout_releasable_release_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_releasable_release_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.created_dynamic }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = {
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scopes value = THIS } }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries value = THIS } }
				has_country_flag = fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_committed
				has_variable = fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.retired_landless }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.preserved_event_package }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = { tag = PREV }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.player_reserved }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This row survives tag and ownership mutation and
# records how every frozen input conflict was resolved.
fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_is_current = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_recorded
	has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved
	NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending }
	has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_generation
	has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation
	has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution
	has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner
	has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_live_tag_conflict_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_live_tag_conflict_generation
		value = global.fallout_successor_allocation_source_inventory_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution > constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.none }
	check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution < constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.upper_bound }
	var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = { exists = yes }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_human
			has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_player_reserved
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_human }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_player_reserved }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_player_reserved
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.player_reserved }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_player_reserved }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_event_package_owned
				has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_request_actor
			}
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.preserved_event_package }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_player_reserved }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_event_package_owned }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_request_actor }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.player_reserved }
					check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.preserved_event_package }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_provenance_is_current = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.retired_landless }
			NOT = { any_owned_state = { always = yes } }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed }
			NOT = { has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.retired_landless } }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed
				has_variable = fallout_successor_conflict_source_country
				has_variable = fallout_successor_conflict_result
				has_variable = fallout_successor_conflict_resolution_generation
				has_variable = fallout_successor_cleanup_owner
				has_variable = fallout_successor_cleanup_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_successor_conflict_result
					value = PREV.fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_successor_conflict_resolution_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_successor_cleanup_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
				var:fallout_successor_conflict_source_country = { tag = PREV.PREV }
				var:fallout_successor_cleanup_owner = {
					tag = var:PREV.PREV.fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the structural dynamic post-allocation
# proof. It does not require pre-allocation owner rows to remain current after
# valid mutation, and it does not read the global transition error ledger.
fallout_successor_allocation_ledger_structure_is_current = {
	has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized
	fallout_successor_preallocation_consumption_is_current = yes
	fallout_player_planning_ledger_is_current = yes
	has_variable = global.fallout_successor_allocation_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version
	has_variable = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_successor_allocation_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version
		value = constant:fallout_successor_allocation_schema.version
		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	fallout_successor_assignment_ledger_is_aligned = yes
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries
		fallout_successor_assignment_country_row_is_current = yes
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states
		fallout_successor_assignment_capital_row_is_current = yes
	}
	all_of_scopes = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		fallout_player_target_matches_conflict_output = yes
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			exists = yes
			any_owned_state = { always = yes }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS } }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the pre-allocation player barrier. It
# accepts either a preserved in-place target or an explicit materialization
# request, but it never treats an unresolved request as a completed target.
fallout_player_allocation_reservation_row_is_current = {
	has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_country
	has_variable = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
	has_variable = fallout_player_continuation_branch
	has_variable = fallout_player_continuation_status
	check_variable = {
		var = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
	is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries value = THIS }
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
			has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
			has_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_player_origin_generation
				value = global.fallout_transition_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
			NOT = { fallout_state_has_current_player_reservation = yes }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_continues_old_country
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			has_variable = fallout_player_primary_target
			has_variable = fallout_player_primary_capital_state
			check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.surviving_tag }
			check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.primary_reserved }
			var:fallout_player_primary_target = { tag = PREV }
			var:fallout_player_primary_capital_state = {
				has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
				has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
				var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
				fallout_state_has_current_player_reservation = yes
				has_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_player_successor_choice_required
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.choice_pending }
			check_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch > constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.surviving_tag }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_player_continuation_branch
				value = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.emergency_council
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		fallout_player_continuation_commit_is_valid = yes
	}
}

		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. These are the diplomacy surfaces that have both a
# documented reset effect and a documented validation trigger.
fallout_old_world_diplomacy_proven_surfaces_are_clean = {
	NOT = { any_country = { has_war = yes } }
	NOT = { any_country = { has_civil_war = yes } }
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { has_truce_with = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { civilwar_target = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = { any_country = { is_in_faction = yes } }
	NOT = { any_country = { is_subject = yes } }
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			OR = {
				is_government_in_exile = yes
				is_exile_host = yes
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { has_guaranteed = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { has_military_access_to = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = { is_embargoing = PREV }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = {
				has_volunteers_amount_from = {
					tag = PREV
					count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
				}
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_other_country = {
				has_collaboration = {
					target = PREV
					value > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
				}
			}
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_country = {
			any_purchase_contract = { always = yes }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			any_country = { has_resources_rights = { state = PREV } }
		}
	}
	NOT = { any_country = { is_in_peace_conference = yes } }
}

		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}
}

	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_verified
	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_applied
	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_verified
	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_applied
	has_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_verified

	has_variable = global.fallout_transition_docking_rights_verification_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_transition_market_access_reset_generation
	has_variable = global.fallout_transition_market_access_verification_generation

		compare = equals
	}

		var = global.fallout_transition_market_access_reset_generation

		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_market_access_verification_generation

		compare = equals
	}
	check_variable = {
		var = global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_generation
		value = global.fallout_transition_generation
		compare = equals
	}

	}
